name: Maw Legion
description: March a legion of maws over the field that drains each soul in its path.

name: Endless Siphon
description: Hold a siphon that never ends on one foe and press down his will as it feeds.

name: Hungering Aegis
description: Wear an aegis of hunger that eats soul strikes and turns them into strength.

name: Famished Verdict
description: Pass a famished verdict on one soul that strikes it and holds it still.

name: Boundless Absorption
description: Absorb every soul attack in range into one reserve without a limit.

name: Marrow Unmaking
description: Unmake the marrow of a foe's soul from within and leave his body untouched.

name: Starved Passage
description: Pass through guards and wards by starving them of the force that holds them.

name: Ravening Flash
description: Flash to the richest soul in range and gorge on it before the foes can react.

name: Voracious Reign
description: Reign over the field as a hunger that no soul may resist for as long as the reserve holds.

name: Ageless Hunger
description: Feed the old hunger of the soul with a heavy gorge that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Eternal Appetite
description: Hold an appetite that grows with every blow taken and returns it as strength.

name: Ruin Maw
description: Open a maw of ruin over a multitude up to the destructive ceiling of its tier and swallow their force.

name: Devoured Name
description: Devour a being's name from the memory of the world so that no record or witness can say it ever lived.

name: Sovereign Siphon
description: Hold a sovereign siphon on a foe and press down his will while it feeds.

name: Hunger Aegis
description: Cover the user and nearest allies in an aegis that eats attacks and feeds all beneath it.

name: Hunger Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of hunger over a company that strips each soul it names.

name: Famine Decree
description: Decree a famine on a company that presses down the will of every soul in it.

name: Absolute Absorption
description: Absorb any attack of divine force whole and keep it as strength.

name: Soul Unmaking
description: Unmake a foe's soul from within and leave only the husk of the body.

name: Hunger Passage
description: Pass through any barrier by devouring the force that holds it.

name: Famished Flash
description: Flash to any soul in sight and strike before the foe's guard can close.

name: Eternal Hunger
description: Spread the eternal hunger over the field and feed on it by a measure of the reserve.

name: Last Feast
description: Take a last feast on one soul and keep the whole of it for as long as the reserve lasts.

name: Starved Heaven
description: Starve every soul under a whole sky up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Soul Unwoven
description: Eat a soul so wholly that it can neither pass on nor linger as an echo anywhere in the world.
